static_edge_gates.proposal_origin: New conservative screening gates for Human review, not falsely attributed to old production approval. Retained baseline edges outside affected scope remain regression context.
static_edge_gates.no_hard_swap: Reject same-interface one-ring disjoint one-hot drivers, and any new jump beyond these gates; every exceeding edge requires local smoothing or targeted deformation justification before candidate acceptance.
static_edge_gates.comparison: No increase in a preexisting seam over its R1B jump +1e-5 unless explicitly recorded and qualified; existing bad baseline does not waive new absolute gates.
static_edge_gates.profile_gate: Check corrected IP/MCP quintic derivative bound plus physical adjacent-edge continuity; do not prove surface continuity from arc smoothness alone
static_edge_gates.projection_tie_seams: Record nearest-segment arc discontinuities and validate them; no implicit propagation from ownership labels
static_edge_gates.scope_extension: Failed outer seams may extend candidate envelope locally under recorded reason, never default all-mesh rebuild.

cap_IP_MCP_transition: Same corrected longitudinal profile on compatible proximal 1/2-ring thumb support; no cap boundary clamp
first_web_three_way: Thumb/index/palm simultaneous continuity, exact membership not expanded
old_cap9_INDEX_continuity: No crater/spike relative clean INDEX field; continuous constrained interpolation with geometry prior, never all MCP by assumption
safe_reuse: Exact vector hashes retained where permitted; corrected bind, zero pose and local regression must be verified after approved candidate exists
targeted_deformation_gate: DEFORMATION_VALIDATION_REQUIRED: cap-IP/MCP flex, INDEX MCP/PIP, first-web CMC opposition plus wrist/palm, and edge5879 combined CMC/MCP. No runs in this phase.
Stage6: Separate later qualification; Q7 approval is permission for targeted rig/skin candidate rebuild only, never Stage6 or final production promotion
